I can’t determine a document’s exact conclusion or a numeric confidence interval from just the filename. A filename like "forecast-final.pdf" gives no reliable content, and I won’t fabricate specific findings or numbers.

What I can do next:
- If you upload the PDF (or paste the conclusion/results text), I’ll extract the exact conclusion and any reported confidence interval(s).
- If you prefer to find it yourself, search the PDF for terms like “Conclusion”, “Executive Summary”, “Abstract”, “Results”, “confidence interval”, “CI”, “95%”, “90%”, “lower”, “upper”, or “interval” and send the relevant excerpt.

Tell me how you’d like to proceed.
